description:
Engineered with adventure in mind, the DJI Power 1000 Mini powers your journey wherever you go, from camping trips to road travel and creative filmmaking. Reach 80% charge in just 58 minutes and enjoy robust, reliable energy with built-in 400W car flash charging and a high-efficiency MPPT solar charging module. Powerful, portable, and ready for anything.


✅ DJI's Ultra-Portable 1kWh Power Station
✅ High-Efficiency Power, Built to Last
✅ 0-80% Recharge in Just 58 Mins
✅ Built-in 400W Car Charger & MPPT Module
✅ 100W Retractable Cable, Effortless Charging & Storage
✅ Engineered for Secure & Reliable Use
